name: requirements
description: Define and validate software requirements from Jira, Confluence, or approved user stories.
---

# Requirements Skill

## Objective

Transform an approved business User Story into precise, testable software
requirements.

## Procedure

1. Retrieve the User Story using the configured MCP.
2. Preserve the original business intent.
3. Identify actors and stakeholders.
4. Identify functional behavior.
5. Identify non-functional expectations.
6. Identify security requirements.
7. Identify dependencies and constraints.
8. Identify ambiguous requirements.
9. Ask the human clarification questions.
10. Do not invent missing requirements.
11. Define measurable acceptance criteria.
12. Establish traceability from User Story to requirements.

## Quality Rules

Requirements must be:

- specific
- measurable
- testable
- unambiguous
- traceable

## Approval

Never mark the document as APPROVED automatically.

The human owns approval.
